page.layout: One column of italic verse, set in lines with no stanza breaks. Running head top left, page number top right. No marginal notes and no text below the verse.

p.i: Non ulla luctu mœsta caret domus, Plorat mariti funera tristior Coniux, & amisso tenellis Patre timet mala plura natis. Maternus, eheu! quæ dolor excitat Lamenta, telis pectora quum videt Traiecta natorum, paterve[?] Quum senior sepelit cruentos! Quæ cuncta Gallis vulnera Gallicus Fecisse miles gestit acerbius, Francosque victos Francus audet Egregius spoliare victor! Antiqua priscis temporibus fides, Virtúsque Francis subdita Regibus, Hostes remotos impetuit Arma ferens metuenda cunctis: Et signa iustis splendida Laureis Late per orbem Gallica protulit, Duxitque laudatos renidens Barbaricis opibus triumphos. Sed nunc benignus te superum favor, Rex magne, nostris fletibus annuit, Plebes ut oppressas benignus Tabifico releues labore Ultor ligato fortior agmine, Gentisque tandem corda recolligas Diuisa, nec posthac redire Indigenas patiare motus.

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "paterve" (the last letter, marked [?]); "eheu! quæ" (printed "eheu!qua" with a broken line-end mark). Printed text is set in italic throughout, long s normalised to s, and "Vltor" is written as "Ultor" by the u/v rule.
